Our story

Six years of taking care of the small things.

Noor & Co. started in 2019 with 40 suits on a dining table and a very patient family. Today we send thousands of parcels a year — but the routine is unchanged: fabrics are checked in daylight, every seam is looked at, and each order is packed by a person who signs off on it.

No factory walls, no middlemen, no mystery about where your money goes. Just honest clothes at honest prices, with delivery you can rely on.

Good to know

Questions, answered.

Still unsure? WhatsApp us — a real person replies, usually inside 15 minutes between 10am and 10pm.

Chat on WhatsApp

Standard delivery is 2–4 working days in Lahore, Karachi, Islamabad, Rawalpindi and Faisalabad, and 3–6 days for Peshawar, Quetta and smaller towns. Express is 1–2 working days. Every parcel is booked with TCS, Leopards or PostEx and you get the tracking number on WhatsApp.

Yes — anywhere in Pakistan. You pay the rider when the parcel arrives, so nothing is charged in advance. For orders above PKR 15,000 we ask for a small PKR 500 advance to cover courier return fees, adjusted in the final bill.

Seven days from delivery, unused and with tags on. Size exchanges are free; we arrange pickup from your address. Refunds are sent through Easypaisa, JazzCash or bank transfer within three working days of the parcel reaching us.

Open any product's quick view for the full size chart. Our unstitched pieces are 3-piece suits with 2.5m shirt, 2.5m trouser and a 2.5m dupatta. If you are between sizes, go one up for lawn and one down for linen.

Yes. UK, UAE, Saudi Arabia, USA and Canada are served at PKR 4,500 flat per parcel, 7–12 working days. Message us on WhatsApp with the items you want and we will send a payment link.
